description: Rezones Brighton land near Traeger Manor and Asokan Avenue.
Changes zoning from FUDH to R1A and R2 districts.
Allows one to four unit residential dwellings.

chips.text: Adjacent property owners within 150 meters were notified.
Administration received no public correspondence or concerns.

description: Amends St. John's Cathedral heritage designation for property subdivision.
Excludes parish hall, parking lot from heritage designation.
Cathedral's main heritage designation remains unchanged.

chips.text: St. John's Anglican Cathedral subdivides property to sell a portion.
No public objections received regarding the bylaw amendment.

description: Leases 1.061 acres in Grace Adam Metawewinihk Park.
For St. Mary's Wellness and Education Centre student safety.
City pays $8,000 to remove a small hill.

chips.text: Staff noted the request for exclusive use of municipal reserve is atypical.
City's park enhancement fund covers $8,000 for site preparation.
City will involve Ministry of Education in future discussions on similar leases.
